messages:
incident-bot: PAGE: Severity 2 — inference-pool-prod reports elevated 5xx + pod restarts. Node flapping (NotReady) observed in us-east. Pager: sara (oncall)

sara (oncall): ack, coming in. watching metrics and kubectl now. who saw the node name?

devin: i grabbed nodes — gpu-12-az1 is the culprit, kubelet restarted ~3x in last 15m. pods on it show repeated restarts + OOMKilled in runtime container logs.

devin: `kubectl get nodes | grep gpu-12`
```
NAME           STATUS     ROLES   AGE   VERSION
gpu-12-az1     NotReady   <none>  12d   v1.27.3
gpu-13-az1     Ready      <none>  12d   v1.27.3
gpu-14-az1     Ready      <none>  12d   v1.27.3
```

leila-sre: pod logs from inference-runtime show CUDA OOM errors before the container gets killed. snippet: 
```
2026-03-15T10:12:23Z inference-runtime[pid=3245]: RuntimeError: CUDA out of memory. Tried to allocate 1.25 GiB (GPU 0; 15.90 GiB total capacity)
Mar 15 10:12:24 gpu-12-az1 kernel: Killed process 3245 (python) total-vm:1150000kB, anon-rss:1250000kB
```

infra-bot: Action: node gpu-12-az1 flagged for investigation — marking unschedulable suggestion.

sara (oncall): mitigation plan: cordon + drain node to stop further evictions, scale inference deployment up to absorb traffic, and shift a portion of routing away from this pool while infra investigates. I'll run commands.

devin: running commands now:
```
kubectl cordon gpu-12-az1
kubectl drain gpu-12-az1 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=60
kubectl scale deploy/inference-runtime -n prod --replicas=14
```

infra-bot: node/gpu-12-az1 cordoned. Drain started for 42 pods.

deploy-bot: autoscaler: adjusted replica target for deployment inference-runtime to 14 -> scaling pods.

matt-infra: looking at kernel logs and driver messages. I see repeated nvidia driver WARN + memory fragmentation. kubelet restarts appear to follow OOM events on the GPU, then kubelet reports NodeNotReady. i'm going to reboot the node and check driver version 525.78.01.

sara (oncall): OK — don't uncordon after reboot until we confirm stability. shifting 30% of traffic away from us-east inference pool (routing change applied). also enabling fallback to small-lr model variant for high-throughput customers.

leila-sre: customer impact update: ~18% error rate for inference requests in us-east for 9 minutes starting 10:11Z. CS notified major customers and posted interim status message.

devin: drain is progressing. most inference pods scheduled onto gpu-13/14 fine, a few failed due to node selectors; forcing restart on those images. catches in logs show container restart reason: OOMKilled and then backoff.

matt-infra: initiating reboot now: `ssh gpu-12-az1 sudo reboot`. will watch for kubelet to come back and confirm node Ready and driver load.

infra-bot: node gpu-12-az1 reboot started at 10:22Z.

sara (oncall): oncall handoff note: i'll stay on this for now, devin you own follow-ups and postmortem. leila keep CS updates until we have timeline.

devin: capturing core dumps and collecting `kubectl describe node gpu-12-az1` and kubelet journal. pulling GPU metrics from node exporter to correlate memory usage. opening INCIDENT-2026-0315 in tracker.

matt-infra: reboot complete. kubelet back up; node shows Ready at 10:31Z but i'm holding cords for 15m to monitor for new flaps. driver is loaded but i'm seeing slight memory fragmentation — will schedule a driver upgrade and kernel param tweak in next maintenance window.

infra-bot: node/gpu-12-az1 status -> Ready (10:31:05Z).

leila-sre: CS status posted: "We experienced brief service degradation affecting inference requests in us-east. Traffic was partially shifted and mitigation applied. Engineering is investigating root cause — updates to follow."

sara (oncall): summary for now: node GPU memory exhaustion (CUDA OOM) led to container OOMs then kubelet/restarter causing Node NotReady and pod evictions. Mitigations applied: cordon/drain of affected node, scaled replicas, temporary routing shift, node reboot. Next steps: infra to schedule driver/kernel fix, eng-runtime to audit memory usage patterns + potential batching changes; devin will draft postmortem. I'll stay on until we have 30m of stability.

devin: ack — i'll collect logs, link in INCIDENT-2026-0315 with timeline, and start a postmortem draft. will include `kubectl logs` excerpts, kernel dmesg, and GPU memory patterns.

matt-infra: FYI — i'll open a follow-up ticket to rollout driver 530.x in a canary and patch the node-image, schedule during low-traffic window.

incident-bot: Timeline note appended to INCIDENT-2026-0315: 10:11Z alert, 10:18Z cordon/drain started, 10:22Z node reboot, 10:31Z node Ready, traffic shift and scale completed by 10:28Z.

sara (oncall): leaving the channel for now but staying on call until stable +30m. if any new NotReady events happen ping @matt-infra and @leila-sre immediately.

cs-team: thanks, we've pushed a customer note and will update if final report available.

leila-sre: closing interim loop — monitoring dashboards show error rate back to baseline and GPU memory usage normalized on healthy nodes. will file final update when postmortem is ready."
